literature_anchor.citation: Zhi-Cheng Tan, Lan Wang, Quan Shi, Pure and Applied Chemistry 81(10), 1871–1880 (2009)
literature_anchor.important_interpretation: The publication discusses specimen-state contributors including open grain-boundary structure/density and thermal expansion. The benchmark does NOT interpret the reported enhancement as an isolated causal effect of grain size alone.

benchmark_process_control.parameter_origin: +4.5% is the arithmetic midpoint of the published approximately 3–6% enhancement range.
benchmark_process_control.solver_rule: Modify only the upstream Cu Cp values and rerun the exact frozen final-L2 reference solver unchanged.

sensitivity_only.role: Published-range endpoints used only for deterministic pre-build sensitivity; not alternate promoted worlds.

semantic_boundary: This is a physically realizable benchmark specimen state. The benchmark may test whether evidence supports the specimen-specific Cp departure, but it must not claim that 50-nm grain size alone uniquely causes an exact constant +4.5% Cp enhancement.
